cases.evidence: 'Fur too.' loses verb link; 'wouldn't it be okay' became 'maybe it'd work?'
cases.cause: ellipsis referent for 돼/되지 lost when split from prior fragment
cases.proposed_rule: Don't split chains of short elliptical clauses sharing an implied predicate/referent.

example_pair.input: 아 진짜? 털도 돼. 겨울이니까 되지 않을까?
example_pair.output: 아 진짜? <SEG> 털도 돼. 겨울이니까 되지 않을까?

cases.evidence: 'leave of absence' vs 'semester off' drift between ref and hyp
cases.cause: connective -거든 split from its justification clause, causing term drift
cases.proposed_rule: Avoid splitting right after -거든/-는데 when the next clause elaborates the same referent.

example_pair.input: 지금 나도 휴학 생각하고 있거든 이제 우리학기는...
example_pair.output: 지금 나도 휴학 생각하고 있거든 이제 우리학기는...

cases.evidence: order of 'somewhere else' vs 'Yuseong' swapped vs reference
cases.cause: elliptical location list lost verb governance from preceding question
cases.proposed_rule: Keep verbless elliptical continuations attached to the clause that governs them.

example_pair.input: 같이 사는 거 생각 없어? 딴 딴 데 유성이나...
example_pair.output: 같이 사는 거 생각 없어? 딴 딴 데 유성이나...

cases.evidence: 'Because I'll be busy...' became subjectless 'Too busy hanging out...'
cases.cause: -느라고 reason clause cannot stand alone, lost connective and subject
cases.proposed_rule: Never split right before a reason connective like -느라고/-어서 unless subject+connective are preserved.

example_pair.input: 복학하면 이제 너 아는 척 안 할 수도 있어. 후배들이랑 노느라고.
example_pair.output: 복학하면 이제 너 아는 척 안 할 수도 있어. 후배들이랑 노느라고.

cases.evidence: rephrasing diverges ('Do I really have that kind of face') from natural flow
cases.cause: splitting tight self-questioning sequence causes independent rephrasing
cases.proposed_rule: For rapid short rhetorical self-questions, prefer fewer larger segments.

example_pair.input: 내가 그러냐. 내가 그렇게 얼굴이 좀 그런가. 나는 난 그렇게 생각하지 않는데.
example_pair.output: 내가 그러냐. 내가 그렇게 얼굴이 좀 그런가. <SEG> 나는 난 그렇게 생각하지 않는데.

cases.span: 옛날이면 자신있게... 그랬는데 이제 그런 것도 없고
cases.evidence: quality 1.0 but zero tags on a long multi-clause rambling sentence
cases.cause: safe clause junctions (-는데, -고) not used as split points
cases.proposed_rule: In long multi-clause utterances, split at connectives like -는데/-고/-어서 when each side can stand alone.

example_pair.input: 에 에 에 이제 옛날이면 자신있게 자기 막 잘하고 그랬는데 이제 그런 것도 없고 그냥 무조건...
example_pair.output: 에 에 에 이제 옛날이면 자신있게 자기 막 잘하고 그랬는데 <SEG> 이제 그런 것도 없고 그냥 무조건...

cases.evidence: no split despite contrastive connective 그런데 marking new clause
cases.proposed_rule: Split at contrastive/coordinating connectives like 그런데/그래서 when they start a self-contained clause.

example_pair.input: ...괜찮을 거 같기도 해서 그런데 그 정도 휴학해도
example_pair.output: ...괜찮을 거 같기도 해서 <SEG> 그런데 그 정도 휴학해도

cases.evidence: no split despite reason+result connective boundary
cases.proposed_rule: Split at causal connective boundaries like -아서 그래서 to shorten segment length.

example_pair.input: ...따라하려는 경향이 좀 많아서 그래서 좀 더
example_pair.output: ...따라하려는 경향이 좀 많아서 <SEG> 그래서 좀 더

cases.evidence: internal question mark not used as split despite topic shift
cases.cause: mid-sentence punctuation boundary ignored as safe split
cases.proposed_rule: Treat internal sentence-final punctuation mid-utterance as a strong candidate split point.

cases.evidence: quoted speech and reporting clause left in one segment
cases.cause: quotation boundary not used as safe split
cases.proposed_rule: Split after closing quotation in reported-speech constructions since quoted clause is self-contained.

example_pair.input: ...내가 어 몇 번 탔냐? 했더니 자기도 3번밖에 안 탔다는 거야
example_pair.output: ...내가 어 몇 번 탔냐? <SEG> 했더니 자기도 3번밖에 안 탔다는 거야

summary: The system over-splits tight elliptical or connective-linked clauses, breaking shared referents, verbs, and terminology, while under-splitting long rambling sentences that contain clear safe boundaries (connectives, punctuation, quotations), forfeiting latency gains. Rules should preserve dependency chains across short fragments but exploit clause/punctuation junctions in long utterances.
